user.title: ESP32 Screen
user.description: Adds the Screens panel to the sidebar, where you design the layout of each wall screen. Screens appear there after they log in to Home Assistant. Give every screen its own non-admin user.

abort.single_instance_allowed: ESP32 Screen is already set up. All screens are managed from the Screens panel.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Shows a notification on ESP32 screens, optionally with a camera or image snapshot.

device_id.name: Screens
device_id.description: Screens to notify. Leave empty for all screens.

image_entity.name: Image
image_entity.description: Camera or image entity whose current picture is shown.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds until the notification closes; 0 keeps it until dismissed.

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Closes a notification on ESP32 screens.

device_id.name: Screens
device_id.description: Screens to dismiss on. Leave empty for all screens.

id.name: Notification ID
id.description: ID returned by the notify action. Leave empty to close any notification.
